hooks.command: f=$(python -c "import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path') or '')" 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in *.py) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; r=$(python -m ruff check "$f" 2>&1); rc=$?; m=""; mrc=0; case "$f" in *dungeon_daddy*) m=$(python -m mypy "$f" 2>&1); mrc=$? ;; esac; if [ $rc -ne 0 ] || [ $mrc -ne 0 ]; then { echo "$r"; echo "$m"; } >&2; exit 2; fi
